title: LiveElementStatePayload
description: live.element.state v1 (OpenVibe.Live server/elements): an element's own store changed, broadcast to everyone watching through Live's existing events path. Same fields as ui.element-state@1: the channel, the element instance, a revision that grows by one per accepted change, the values themselves and when. It is public state (a counter, a score, a wheel's entries), never the presser's data: a value may not be an object, a markup string or a URL, and the payload carries no account.
